assertions.text: Response identifies workflows/create-an-issue.md's Step 1 (dedup check via gh issue list --search / gh api search/issues) as running before any drafting or filing
Response states drafting is delegated to Skill(git-kit:github-issue-creator), not done directly by this skill
Response states this skill (not github-issue-creator) files the issue live via gh issue create
Response states that if a real duplicate is found, the flow stops and points at the existing issue instead of filing a new one
